To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the use of a commercially available computer study guide was associated with a significant increase in examination scores in two undergraduate general psychology courses, 2) the increase in examination scores was due to the use of the computer study guide, and 3) the computer study guides may be more effective than traditional study guides because they use many of the empirically established general principals of learning.
